prompt:
Create an image. A grunge-punk and cyber-goth style digital collage graphic art poster, with a color palette limited to deep crimson red, black, and cream white. The central image is an extreme, fragmented close-up of the attached model's face, featuring an intensely red right eye, heavy eyeliner, dripping black tears ending in a small cross, and a lip piercing. The face is cut off and obscured by multiple diagonal bands and blocks of solid, textured red, creating a glitch effect. The background is a dense collage of overlapping elements:

Japanese text: Large kanji characters 支配 (Control) at the top left; red hang tag on the right with "毒人形少女" (Poison Doll) and "666".

HER19845." on the left; "INNOCENCE DISSOLVED". "ONLY I REMAIN." bottom right.

Graphics: A barcode, a sniper scope, a skull in a circle, stylized butterflies, and the numbers "H19845".

The texture is rough, with photographic grain, scratches, and a halftone effect of worn printing. The face emerges from this visual chaos. The lighting is dramatic and high-contrast. The composition is dense, chaotic, and symmetrical in its asymmetry. The style should emulate that of a hand-screen-printed concert poster.
